body: CHECKPOINT after accepted review findings. Focused courts are green: CompilerSuite Passed 15/15 and raw-source/raw-recall vertical Passed 1/1, warning-clean. Root context is now derived only from accepted per-situation ContextAssignment records; ContextAssignment and the new explicit SegmentMembership family are high-impact under Conservative policy. Primary containment edges come only from accepted per-member proposals. Provider values no longer contain EpistemicStatus, and the first slice rejects non-Asserted modalities because it cannot represent child contexts. Multi-situation input now records a DiscourseTrajectory gap, leaves the trajectory empty, and blocks promotion instead of calling the current absence-erasing derive path. NarrativeCompilation and DerivationReceipt are non-case checked constructions with structural equality; candidate identity now includes policy, full proposals, findings, receipts, calibration, provenance, evidence, gaps, and length-framed values. Reference checks include sentence/chart identity, span-unit containment, surrogate boundaries, inline-ledger consistency, conflicts, critic targets, and rejection of undeclared upstream claims. The WOG vertical now runs an honestly named deterministic pure-Scala fixture provider and claims one-sentence mechanical reachability only; it does not wrap handwritten literals in Agent provenance. ADR replay language is structural equality plus content fingerprint, with canonical bytes deferred to codec. Please review the current isolated-worktree snapshot read-only against your prior blockers; no gate verdict requested yet.
